newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian annual inflation falls to 24.4 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian annual inflation falls to 24.4 pct in Feb.

text.p: Annual inflation in Nigeria fell to 24.4 percent in February, 1997, from 26.7 percent in January, the government statistics office said on Thursday.
It said in its monthly consumer price report that prices of food staples such as yams and beans rose but those of manufactured items such as home appliances dropped.

"The 'all items excluding farm produce index' which measures changes in the average level of retail prices consumers pay for services and manufactured goods fell by 0.5 percent in February, 1997," it added.
Taming inflation is an objective of Nigeria's military government, which has set an inflation target of 15 percent for 1997, compared with an average 28 percent in 1996.
Analysts said while the overall inflationary trend was down, the increase in the price of staples was worrying.
